title: Release decision ticker and compact escrow checklist
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, operational-first note for short-window releases that need a small decision ticker and an escrow mechanism for traffic. The goal: give on-call and release leads a 1-page decision flow + 72h micro-calendar + staffing sprintlet so we can safely push and unwind changes without a heavyweight launch.

Context / why this exists:
- We run many small changes (config flips, kernel patches, routing tweaks) that are low-risk but interact with traffic in subtle ways.
- Historically our full-run runbooks were overkill and slowed responders during small rollouts.
- Compact escrow: a short-lived traffic escrow where incoming traffic is staged behind a throttle/proxy for quick rollback and sampling.

Decision ticker (one-line signals):
- GREEN: 0.0-0.5% error delta, latency p50 change < 5ms, user-visible errors unchanged -> proceed to widen per schedule.
- AMBER: error delta 0.5-2% OR latency p50 change 5-20ms OR increased tail (p95+p99) -> hold, run focused mitigation tests, consider partial revert.
- RED: error delta > 2% OR latency p50 change > 20ms OR saturation on capacity -> immediate rollback to last stable + escalate.

How to use ticker:
- Lead reads the ticker every 5 minutes during first 30 minutes, then every 15m for the next 2 hours, then hourly until escrow is released.
- If any signal crosses into AMBER, annotate the timeline (who saw it, immediate next step).

Compact escrow checklist (preflight, staging -> escrow -> release):
Preflight (T-24h to T-1h):
- Confirm PRs merged and pinned manifests available (list PR numbers).
- Sanity-run smoke tests against staging canary (end-to-end synthetic queries).
- Validate telemetry hooks: request id tagging, route labels, and sampling flags.
- Prepare quick-revert runbook snippet with exactly 3 steps and CLI commands.
- Ensure coverage: at least one SRE + one service owner on-call for first 2 hours of escrow.

Escrow activation (T0):
- Open escrow window: route 5% of traffic into escrow proxy with concentrated sampling (10x) for first 20 minutes.
- Enable detailed tracing for escrowed cluster (lower sampling threshold, max 5s retention for debug traces).
- Run smoke queries: edge-case prompts and high-seq-length flows if applicable.
- Start Decision Ticker monitoring sheet and notify slack #rollout-watch with the short url.

Escrow widen plan (if GREEN):
- T0+20m: widen to 20% if signals stable for two consecutive 10m windows.
- T0+60m: widen to 50% if telemetry green and no latent regressions seen.
- T0+120m: widen to 100% and schedule escrow release at T0+180m after final sweep.

Escrow rollback (if AMBER/RED):
- Pause widening immediately.
- If AMBER: run targeted mitigation (replay prefix, lower batch sizes, reduce kv cache TTL) and hold for 30m with 15m reevaluations.
- If RED: execute quick-revert script in runbook (CLI command included below) and drop escrow percent to 0%, restore prior route config.
- Notify incident channel and attach ticker logs + sample traces.

Quick-revert script (example):
- infractl route set --route release-2028-04 --percent 0 --from backup-route-2028-02
- infractl rollback --service srv-infer --to-tag stable-2028-02
- postmortem checklist kick: create RL-XXXX in JIRA and ping on-call.

72-hour micro-calendar (annotated):
Day 0 (launch):
- T-2h: final signoff and go/no-go.
- T0: activate escrow at 5% with ticker running.
- T0+20m, T0+60m, T0+120m: decision points to widen.
- T0+180m: escrow release if all green.
Day 1: observation and sampling
- Morning: 0800 local check-in, quick bucketed traffic sanity (common vs edge flows).
- 1000: short retro if any anomalies (15m).
- Evening: 1800 follow-up check and extended trace retention if needed.
Day 2: metric drift review + ramp plan for next week (if applicable)
Day 3: final release note draft due and closure.

Staffing sprintlet (who does what):
- Release lead (owner): coordinates decisions, makes call to widen/rollback, updates ticker.
- SRE responder: runs infractl actions, watches capacity, runs quick-revert if requested.
- Service owner: triages functional failures, reads trace samples, inspects logs.
- Observability lead: inspects telemetry, assembles the 10-sample anomalies, updates dashboard.
- Comms + CS liaison: preps brief for customers if visibility/latency impacts expected.

Release notes draft (skeleton to copy into public release digest):
- Version: 2028.04.02-compact-escrow
- Highlights: Small traffic routing improvements and kernel scheduling patch intended to reduce tokenizer latency for long sequences.
- Why: Observed p50 improvements in internal bench.
- Risk & mitigation: Staged rollout behind a compact escrow with immediate rollback plan; low initial traffic.
- Rollout timeline: Escrow started 2028-04-02 13:00 UTC; fully widened by 2028-04-02 16:00 UTC after validation.
- Impacted services: inference-router, kv-cache-service, telemetry-api.
- Rollback contact: on-call SRE + release lead (Ava Kim).

Open questions / TODOs (notes-to-self):
- Add exact PR numbers for the kernel scheduling change (link missing).
- Confirm required quota bump for extra tracing retention (billing approval?).
- Decide if we want longer escrow for multi-region shipments.
- Get signoff from privacy/security if trace retention exceeds 30 days.

Attached snippets and shortcuts (copyable):
- Command to start escrow proxy (internal): docker run --rm esc-proxy --route release-2028-04 --percent 5 --sample 10
- Quick dashboard query: select count(*) from requests where route='release-2028-04' and error=true since 20m

Notes on observability thresholds (practical guidance):
- Use rolling windows of 10m and 1h for decisioning; require two consecutive 10m windows of stability before widening.
- Watch both absolute and relative metrics: small teams can miss absolute saturation if only looking at deltas.

References and links to canonical runbooks: CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-1221 (compact escrow spec), RUNBOOK-ESCROW-V1, JIRA-RL-8932.

Draft log snippet to paste into retro after release:
- 13:00 Escrow opened at 5% (Ava). No anomalies during first 20m.
- 13:20 Widen to 20% (Ava). p95 increased by 6ms but error delta 0.2% (within green).
- 14:15 Widen paused for 10m due to redis throttling; SRE reduced batch size and resumed.
- 16:00 Escrow released to 100% after mitigation and final checks.

End of doc.

(If this looks useful, i'll turn the quick-revert and start commands into automation tasks in infra repo and add exact PR links.)
